policy: One coherent mechanical source cluster maximum by default. Use migration-map.md to choose; no automatic moves are authorized by a suggested path.

no_move_rationale.rationale: The current native foundation already groups public contracts under include/GlassHelix, Cellerator-backed assembly under src/system, replay under src/artifacts, and focused checks under tests/native_foundation. The benchmark, Python package, and binding are each referenced directly by CMake and have useful existing boundaries. No source cluster showed a navigation benefit sufficient to justify path churn. ML2 remains an active queued integration; keeping source paths stable preserves its existing continuation routes.
no_move_rationale.continuity: No source, build, import, export, include, evidence, or Todo paths were moved; the active/scheduled ML2 work remains continuable.
